steps.raw:
THOUGHT: I will retrieve the patient’s most recent serum potassium observation using the provided patient ID and potassium code.

THOUGHT: I need the potassium result before determining whether replacement is indicated, so I am querying the latest available result.

THOUGHT: I will verify the patient record so the subsequent medication and lab orders reference the correct FHIR patient identifier.

THOUGHT: I will search the potassium observation by the supplied base code without a date restriction to obtain the most recent available result.

THOUGHT: I will also query the standard LOINC identifier for serum potassium to ensure the latest result is captured if the chart indexes the observation by LOINC rather than the base code.

THOUGHT: The latest potassium is below the 3.5 mEq/L goal, so I will order oral potassium replacement calculated at 10 mEq per 0.1 mEq/L deficit.

THOUGHT: I will pair the replacement with a repeat morning serum potassium measurement scheduled for 8:00 AM the following day.

THOUGHT: The potassium replacement and next-morning serum potassium order have been placed, completing the requested task.

FINISH(["Most recent potassium was low at 3.2 mEq/L. Ordered 30 mEq oral potassium replacement (10 mEq per 0.1 mEq/L below the 3.5 goal). Ordered repeat serum potassium (LOINC 2823-3) for 2023-11-14 at 08:00."])
